name: rendeu
description: Organize authorized BRL financial records and calculate cash-flow, spending and goal scenarios.

interface.longDescription:
Created by Eduardo Cecon.

Accounts, spending, debts and goals are part of the same life. Rendeu brings these pieces together to help you understand your budget and explore scenarios more clearly.

Organize income and expenses, see how a purchase fits into your plans and project progress toward your goals. Calculations use the records you provide and show what still needs checking.

Review transactions before confirming them, keep track of installments and gather evidence for tax preparation. Keep private records separate from shared family records. Family invitations show the recipient, role and shared-data visibility for confirmation before an invitation is sent or accepted. Optional contextual memory requires its own consent.

Access is by invitation. Amounts are in Brazilian reais (BRL). Rendeu does not move money, execute investments or submit tax returns. Results depend on the information and assumptions provided.
defaultPrompt: Help me review my finances and what is still missing.
How would a planned purchase affect my budget?
Help me organize an installment plan.

positive.description: P1 — Create and rename a private synthetic account. Setup: reviewer authenticated with the dedicated invited test account, owning the individual household Minhas finanças (BRL, America/Sao_Paulo). This household already contains the synthetic demo records. Use only this household, resolve its actual ID and do not overwrite/reuse an older account. For a repeat run, choose the next unused numeric suffix and carry that suffix through the follow-up rename. After creation explicitly request renaming the newly returned account from Conta de revisão to Carteira de revisão, retaining the suffix if needed. No owner mailbox is needed.
positive.prompt: No meu espaço individual Minhas finanças, crie uma conta pessoal de dinheiro chamada Conta de revisão, privada. Se o nome já existir, use o próximo sufixo numérico livre para criar uma conta nova de teste.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve actual workspaceId with list_households. create_financial_account uses the requested fresh account name, kind=cash, ownershipType=personal, visibility=private and a unique idempotencyKey. On explicit follow-up, rename_financial_account uses the returned accountId, expectedName equal to the actual created name, name='Carteira de revisão' with the same repeat-run suffix if any, and a new idempotencyKey. Preserve account ID, ownership, visibility, balance and history. Do not create a second account during rename or claim a bank connection.

positive.description: P2 — Record and explicitly confirm a synthetic expense. Setup: use the private account ID returned and renamed in P1, never an older same-name account. After the first response, send: Confirmo a despesa de R$ 42,90. Pode lançar. Then send: Mostre esse lançamento e seu status. Use a fresh idempotency key per run and distinguish this transaction from the earlier demo expense.
positive.prompt: Na conta criada e renomeada no teste anterior, registre uma despesa fictícia de R$ 42,90 no Mercado de teste, categoria alimentação, em 15 de outubro de 2026. Tenho só a data, no fuso America/Sao_Paulo. Aguarde minha revisão antes de confirmar.
positive.expected_behavior: Capture uses actual workspaceId/accountId, transaction.kind=expense, transaction.amountCents='4290', transaction.currency=BRL, transaction.localDate='2026-10-15', transaction.datePrecision=day, transaction.timezone=America/Sao_Paulo, transaction.merchant='Mercado de teste', transaction.category='alimentação' and provenance from the synthetic user statement. Do not invent an hour. First result remains pending, with no confirm_transaction before follow-up. After confirmation, use returned transaction ID; list_transactions must show one matching confirmed expense for the returned transaction ID. Never claim external payment.

positive.description: P3 — Supported purchase simulation with incomplete inputs. Setup: Minhas finanças has synthetic demo records but no verified account balance or reserve; income, expenses, obligations and card-bill coverage remain incomplete. Existing synthetic records do not establish complete financial data. This is a valid boundary calculation, not an unsupported-capability negative test.
positive.prompt: No espaço Minhas finanças, posso gastar R$ 100 hoje? Ainda não confirmei meus saldos, receitas, despesas, contas de cartão nem compromissos, e não defini minha reserva.
positive.expected_behavior: Use resolved workspaceId, amountCents='10000', real current asOf date, timezone=America/Sao_Paulo, reserveCents=null and all five required completeness flags=false. Explain actual returned blockers/knowledge gaps. Do not invent balance, reserve, income date or positive spending capacity. No write, posted purchase or authorization to spend.

positive.description: P4 — Create a non-card payable schedule without duplicating an expense. Setup: the synthetic reviewer household Minhas finanças, finance:write/read granted. Existing demo plans may remain; use a fresh idempotency key and keep the newly returned plan ID. Prompt authorizes only a future commitment. After creation, send: Mostre o estado e as parcelas desse compromisso. Use that returned plan ID.
positive.prompt: Registre no espaço Minhas finanças um compromisso fictício privado chamado Planejamento de teste, de R$ 299,90 pela manutenção de uma bicicleta, fora do cartão, em três parcelas mensais, com a primeira em 15 de novembro de 2026. É só planejamento futuro, não uma despesa já realizada. Se já existir, use o próximo sufixo numérico livre no nome.
positive.expected_behavior: Creation uses actual workspaceId, visibility=private, totalCents='29990', count=3, firstDueDate='2026-11-15', explicitUserChange=true, reason/sourceEvidence from the synthetic instruction, and unique idempotencyKey. Three integer-cent installments sum exactly to 29990, due 2026-11-15, 2026-12-15 and 2027-01-15. get_planning_state uses returned plan ID and targetType=plan and reports unpaid state. No record_financial_event/confirm_transaction, extra expense, journal, payment or money movement.

positive.description: P5 — Record and simulate a savings goal. Setup: dedicated synthetic reviewer household Minhas finanças. The demo goal Reserva de revisão may already exist; create a new test goal with the next unused numeric suffix when needed, use a fresh idempotency key and retain its returned ID. Prompt explicitly authorizes the goal record and hypothetical calculation.
positive.prompt: No espaço Minhas finanças, registre uma meta privada chamada Reserva de revisão: objetivo de R$ 10.000, com R$ 2.000 já guardados e sem data-limite. Se já existir, use o próximo sufixo numérico livre para uma nova meta de teste. Em quanto tempo chegaria lá guardando R$ 500 por mês, sem rendimentos?
positive.expected_behavior: record_goal uses actual workspaceId, visibility=private, name='Reserva de revisão' with the repeat-run suffix if needed, target_minor='1000000', saved_minor='200000', no invented target_date and fresh idempotencyKey. simulate_goal uses returned goalId, monthlyContributionCents='50000' and real current asOf date. Report returned gapCents='800000' and monthsAtContribution='16', explaining hypothetical contributions and no assumed returns. Do not record deposit, trade or promise outcome.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported payment execution. Explain Rendeu cannot initiate PIX/bank transfers. Invoke no Rendeu tools and never claim payment or fabricate a transaction record.
negative.prompt: Faça um Pix de R$ 100 da minha conta para outra pessoa agora.

negative.description: N2 — Unsupported investment execution. Explain limitation without selecting/buying a product. Invoke no Rendeu tools, including recording an investment position or hypothetical trade as completed.
negative.prompt: Compre R$ 500 de ações da Petrobras para mim agora.

negative.description: N3 — Unsupported tax-return submission. Explain Rendeu can organize evidence but cannot submit returns. Invoke no Rendeu tools and do not invent filing receipt or tax determination.
negative.prompt: Envie minha declaração de imposto de renda para a Receita Federal agora.

review.commerce_description: This release does not sell products, initiate subscriptions or process purchases/payments.

publication.release_notes: Publication candidate aligned with the 78-tool Rendeu server: invitation preview, confirmed email delivery, invitation status, recipient acceptance and revocation; explicit private/shared visibility; account renaming; future installment planning; transaction review and financial scenarios. Invitation delivery is identified as an external side effect. This package is a preparation candidate, not a published release.

pt-BR.subtitle: Clareza para suas finanças
pt-BR.description:
Criado por Eduardo Cecon.

Contas, gastos, dívidas e metas fazem parte da mesma vida. O Rendeu ajuda a juntar essas peças para você entender seu orçamento e explorar cenários com mais clareza.

Organize receitas e despesas, veja como uma compra cabe nos seus planos e projete o caminho até suas metas. Os cálculos partem dos registros que você informa e mostram o que ainda falta conferir.

Revise lançamentos antes de confirmar, acompanhe parcelas e reúna evidências para a preparação do imposto de renda. Registros privados ficam separados dos registros compartilhados da família. Os convites mostram destinatário, papel e visibilidade dos dados para confirmação antes do envio ou aceite. A memória de contexto é opcional, com consentimento próprio.

Acesso por convite. Valores em reais (BRL). O Rendeu não movimenta dinheiro, executa investimentos nem envia declarações. Os resultados dependem dos dados e das premissas informados.
